title: Restricted width of a term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals with pairwise distinct coordinates, and let $\\rho$ assign each coordinate either no restriction or a fixed sign. If any literal is falsified by $\\rho$, define the restricted width of $T$ to be $0$; otherwise, it is the number of literals whose coordinates are unrestricted.
